name: How long does a typical surface restoration project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical surface restoration project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a surface restoration project varies depending on the type of surface, the extent of the damage, and the size of the area. Minor repairs might take a day or two, while larger or more complex projects, such as extensive concrete resurfacing, could take several days to a week. We provide a detailed timeline during the initial assessment and consultation, keeping you informed throughout the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies based on surface type, damage, and area size; minor repairs take days, larger projects up to a week.
